summary: Rocket Companies filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a new $2.5 billion unsecured revolving credit agreement maturing July 2029, and termination of the prior 2025 credit agreement. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. Interest is based on a base rate plus margin, and unused commitments incur a fee based on credit rating. Covenants include net leverage, net debt, minimum liquidity, and tangible net worth. No pricing, premium, stake, or shareholder vote is mentioned. This is a routine refinancing of existing credit facilities, not a special situation.
